title: EC2 Running but Application Unreachable
symptom: EC2 instance status is 2/2 passed, SSH works, but HTTP/HTTPS web requests fail or connection is refused.
initial_observations: Instance responds to ping and SSH.
curl http://<ip> returns 'Connection refused' or hangs.

possible_causes.cause: Application process or web server stopped or crashed
possible_causes.evidence_needed: systemctl status shows inactive or failed.
possible_causes.remediation: Restart service using `sudo systemctl start nginx` and inspect error logs.

possible_causes.cause: Process listening only on localhost (127.0.0.1) instead of 0.0.0.0
possible_causes.remediation: Update application host binding configuration from 'localhost' / '127.0.0.1' to '0.0.0.0'.

investigation_steps.title: Test Local Loopback Connectivity Inside Instance
investigation_steps.explanation: Verify if the web server responds to local requests inside the instance.

investigation_steps.title: Inspect Listening TCP Sockets and Bound Interfaces
investigation_steps.explanation: Determine which processes are listening on which ports and IP addresses.
investigation_steps.what_to_look_for: Look for 0.0.0.0:80 or :::80 in the Local Address column.

verification: curl -I http://<public-ip>:80 returns valid HTTP response.
prevention: Configure process monitoring with Monit or CloudWatch agent.
